A '''COMPNOR company''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
Designed to consist of 157 CompForce troopers from the [[Observation/Legends|observation section]] of the '''[[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]]''', a set of three companies would typically be attached be attached to each [[Army (Imperial Army formation)|army]], [[Systems Army/Legends|systems army]] and [[sector army]] headquarters.<ref name="ISB2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==Role==
{{Main|Observation/Legends}}

The role of the observer company was partially disputed by members of the Galactic Empire. One army view was that their nothing more than political spies. Conversely, troops from [[Assault (CompForce)/Legends|assault section]] of CompForce generally believed they were genuinely there to "learn" how the imperial military operated.

Practically speaking; each [[CompForce Observer|Observer]] made sure that all officers and enlisted personnel showed proper respect to the tenets of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. This contributed to the less than stellar relationship with the imperial military. Although hostility towards a CompForce Observer such as for example an insult could ensure a quick end to anyone's career.<ref name="ISB" />
